summary: Alaska Council of School Administrators opposes any reduction or elimination of E‑Rate, urges preservation of enhanced rural support, and cautions against conflating screen‑time limits with connectivity needs. Alaska school leaders urge the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E‑Rate program, arguing that cuts would disproportionately harm remote districts and undermine essential school operations.
